messages.content: Recheck the Charleston flights and Hyatt House. I want to see the prepaid versus cancellable hotel numbers before we finish this.

The nonstop flights still have three economy seats at the prior total of $1,068: ORD to CHS Friday, March 27, 8:20-11:31 a.m., and CHS to ORD Tuesday, March 31, 4:55-6:31 p.m. The fare is nonrefundable, with changes allowed for a fare difference.

At Hyatt House Charleston/Historic District, the king studio with full-size sofa bed is still available for three guests. The prepaid rate is now $1,318.72 total and cannot be changed or refunded. The flexible rate remains $1,454.64, with no deposit and free cancellation through 11:59 p.m. Eastern on March 25; after that, the penalty is one night, $363.66 including tax. The flexible rate costs $135.92 more.
That difference is small enough. Use the cancellable room. Before booking, walk through the timing and transfers once more.

Friday: depart O'Hare at 8:20 a.m., arrive Charleston at 11:31 a.m., then allow about 20 minutes to reach the rideshare pickup area. The drive to Hyatt House is generally 20-30 minutes, so expected hotel arrival is 12:15-12:35 p.m. Early check-in can be requested, with luggage storage as the fallback.

Tuesday: check out and leave bags with the hotel if needed. For the 4:55 p.m. flight, leave the historic district around 2:30 p.m.; that allows for the airport drive, security, and boarding. No rental car is needed. Two airport rides should run about $56-$80 before tips. O'Hare parking remains budgeted at approximately $90.
Good. Are there actually three seats together on both flights?
Yes. On the outbound, row 18 has A-B-C together. On the return, row 21 has A-B-C together. They are standard economy seats, and seat assignment is included at the current fare.
For this trip, give Owen the window, Daniel the middle, and put me on the aisle so all three of us stay together. Do that both ways.
Understood: Owen in 18A and 21A, Daniel in 18B and 21B, and Marcus in 18C and 21C. This keeps the family together on both flights.
What is the final amount with the flexible hotel and the transportation estimates?

Flights are $1,068.00 and the flexible hotel is $1,454.64, for $2,522.64 in bookable charges. Adding $56-$80 for Charleston airport rides and about $90 for O'Hare parking gives an estimated trip total of $2,668.64-$2,692.64. That excludes meals, ride tips, and activities.
And the room definitely takes three? I don't want a king room that only allows two.

Confirmed. The selected king studio is listed for three occupants and includes one king bed plus a full-size sofa bed. The reservation will name Marcus Lee as the primary guest and list Daniel and Owen as the additional occupants.
All right. Book the flights and that flexible room.

Before I submit: the flights total $1,068 for all three travelers and are nonrefundable, subject to fare difference for changes. The hotel total is $1,454.64, charged at the property, and can be canceled without penalty through 11:59 p.m. Eastern on March 25. The combined chargeable total is $2,522.64. Shall I complete both purchases?

Both bookings are confirmed.

Flights: confirmation H7Q4LM, nonstop ORD-CHS Friday, March 27, 8:20-11:31 a.m., and CHS-ORD Tuesday, March 31, 4:55-6:31 p.m. Total paid is $1,068.00 for Marcus, Daniel, and Owen. Seats are 18C/18B/18A outbound and 21C/21B/21A return, respectively. The tickets are nonrefundable; changes require any fare difference. The airline's 24-hour cancellation window ends tomorrow at 10:18 a.m. Central.

Hotel: Hyatt House Charleston/Historic District, confirmation HH-729461, March 27-31 for four nights in a king studio with full-size sofa bed, three guests. The flexible total is $1,454.64, with no prepayment; the card guarantees the room and payment is due at the hotel. Cancellation is free through 11:59 p.m. Eastern on March 25, then the penalty is $363.66. Early check-in and luggage storage have been noted.

No rental car or transfer was reserved. Plan on rideshare from CHS after arrival and leaving the hotel around 2:30 p.m. Tuesday. Budgeting $56-$80 for those rides and $90 for O'Hare parking puts the complete trip estimate at $2,668.64-$2,692.64 before meals, tips, and activities.
